text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I spotted Oguri Cap and Mejiro 
Ryan heading somewhere in their 
tracksuits.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I'm about to sow some tomato seeds.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Originally, I was planning on helping the 
Chairwoman all by myself. But then..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Oguri-san said it'd be too tough to do 
alone, so she offered to help me out!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I used to sow seeds back in my hometown.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Are you sure? That'd be a big help.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"They say 'three together can lift any 
barbell,' after all!"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
There's a proverb like that? I had no 
idea...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Alright, first I gotta level out the 
field.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: There are some weeds here too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
If we leave them alone, the seeds won't 
grow properly, so we have to pull them 
out...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Working while crouching like this is going 
to require quite a bit of perseverance...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Crouching... In other words, working in a 
squatting posture...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Your hamstrings are sure to be delighted 
with that!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ham... It definitely seems like it would 
go well with tomatoes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Tomatoes are the perfect choice for 
muscle fatigue!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah... For the sake of the ham-tomato, 
first I need to tackle the task right in 
front of me."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
However, there's more to do than I 
expected. Trainer, what do you think I 
should do?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
So we just need to pull the weeds, right? 
Ryan, level the field.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Oguri Cap and I walked around, 
pulling weeds from the surrounding area.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Phew... My knees are trembling... This 
takes more stamina out of me than I 
thought.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
That's the sound of your muscles 
rejoicing!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: The voice of muscles... They can talk?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? I've never heard of such a 
thing, though...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
If you move around in that condition, I 
think your muscles will be even happier!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Now, let's sow the seeds! And please, make 
sure to listen to their voices.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
The voice of muscles... I wonder what it 
sounds like.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after that, I continued sowing the 
tomato seeds while listening to their 
conversation, which somehow seemed in sync 
yet totally disjointed.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Understood. I will level the field, so 
Ryan, please handle the weeds.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yes, squats, right?! Leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no... I just wanted you to pull some 
weeds...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Was my explanation not clear enough?
choice_data_list: I think the message got across.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Is that so...? Oh well, I'll just get on 
with my own work.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Oguri Cap and I leveled the 
field together.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Whew, that was quite the ordeal. I can't 
put any strength into my arms anymore...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
That's proof your muscles are growing. You 
did it, Oguri-san!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I'm feeling the growth in my hamstrings 
more than usual too!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? I don't really get it, but you 
must really love ham and tomato...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I like those, too. I understand the 
excitement... I can't wait for the 
harvest.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after that, I continued sowing the 
tomato seeds while listening to their 
conversation, which somehow seemed in sync 
yet totally disjointed.
